review.scope: Whole unimpregnated wood-derived physically steam-activated powder grade, including actual carbonization, activation, grinding, actual homogenization/formulation and finished-grade first acceptance.
review.source_and_method: Root independently extracted actual Calgon PDF2/4/5 and viewed PDF4: complete physical wood-to-steam-powder branch, explicit homogenization/formulation and separate chemical/washing/mixed variants. Root read actual Gu PDF4–9 process/measurement context: pilot electricity/propane and engineered natural-gas/steam/nitrogen arrangements differ; measured gases are before thermal oxidation, not final emissions. Full Vilén PDF3–6 counterevidence retains granule/product-equivalence limits, energy-sufficiency and residual-feed assumptions, surrogate combustion, startup/ash/wastewater/transport/co-product omissions; none adopted. Root extracted/read actual March1990 DOE Appendix6 PDF148–149 component calibration/GC-TCD and full EPA3C PDF1–4: different sample matrix, H2 absent from3C, real component separation/calibration and wet/dry/dilution limits. No source GC settings/mixture, masses, heat/yield, emission profile or supposed equivalence is a default. Previously reviewed retained Method5/320 principles are reused with source/matrix/dependency limits; complete hot/wet transfer, actual matrix recovery, final outlets and genuine whole utility/control/treatment producers remain actual-study requirements. Missing essential procedure remains an explicit hold, not waived by finite checks. No qualified empirical factory inventory is asserted.
review.native_and_classification: Full state100 whole biomass-derived porous adsorbent Product Biochar-based powdered activated carbon has Mass/kg and no fixed CAS, supplier, activation recipe or geography. Actual wood/steam/powder fits positively; granule device Count record, coal powder/granule inconsistency, generic adsorption-reaction gate and unactivated charcoal are contrary cases retained. Root read full current HS38 notes/3802.10, actual CPC3PDF174 and historical CPC2.1PDF83/305: explicit earlier35499↔3802.10 supports a labeled continuity/narrower inference together with unchanged current residual label. No current individual ruling or all35499 coverage asserted.
review.event_stock_accounting: Original eventQ/cohort fates, full raw/WIP/FG/pack/asset physical ledgers and independent attributable vectors, inherited own history once, whole contaminated Qt and nonoverlapping provider A/Q0 reviewed; no allocation-shrunken physical export or duplicate provider.
review.bilingual: Complete aligned EN/ZH source-qualified scope/reference and bounded critical rule bodies reviewed; all actual typed/literal protocol/source/measurement/calculation/quality/inventory fields and full source/ancestor contexts independently inspected.
review.remaining_limits: Actual configured grade/state/geometry, measured quantities, real complete providers and source/matrix/dependency/site qualification remain study obligations. Missing essential actual procedures remain holds; ordinary unbound identities never become zero or proxies.
